data.title: Parkside Views
data.about:
Embark on a journey where nature blends seamlessly with urban architecture, where your sense of community and individuality both find comfort. 

Explore Parkside Views by Emaar, a refreshing array of meticulously crafted 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments, sophisticated 3-bedroom duplexes, and quaint 3-bedroom townhouses, all nestled among stunning green landscapes. 

With the majestic Burj Al Arab gracing the skyline and the verdant expanse of Dubai Hills Park at your doorstep, along with the nearby allure of Dubai Hills Mall, Parkside Views presents a tranquil haven that you're proud to call home.

characteristics_module.title: Embrace life in a Green Haven!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Diverse residential options including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom units, and elegant 3-bedroom duplexes and townhouses.
  • Access to a range of top-tier amenities.
  • Close proximity to dining, business, retail, and leisure hubs.
  • Located at the heart of a fully-integrated community with premier health, education, and recreational facilities.
  • Prime location on Dubai Hills Park, just a short distance from Dubai Hills Mall.
  • Contemporary design catering to those valuing a balanced lifestyle.
  • Floor-to-ceiling windows.
  • Central location with easy access to Al Khail Road.

location_tile.title: Amazing Connectivity in Dubai HIlls
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Enjoying prime access to Al Khail Road, Parkside Views boasts a location mere minutes from the heart of Downtown Dubai and a host of prime business, retail, and tourism destinations. Furthermore, the anticipated integration with the Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro lines ensures future rapid and effortless commutes to airports and inter-emirate travels.

  • 12 mins to Downtown Dubai
  • 15 mins to Dubai Marina
  • 20 mins to Dxb Int’ Airport
  • 25 mins to Al Maktoum Int’ Airport
